# Inbox reply drafts — 5 samples for approval (decisions 244 and 255)

Drafts only: the portal writes these into info@ as Outlook drafts in the same thread; Jo or Chris presses Send. Nothing is sent automatically (each type stays manual until Jo switches it on).
Decision 255: replies point people to their own homeowner page, never the calculator. A new sender with no job gets an enquiry created from their email (name and email from the email, the address only when the email gives a complete one) and the reply carries that enquiry's own page link; with no address the reply asks for it and the enquiry waits in Enquiries without an address (decision 281: no Fix details pile). Those drafts are always marked “Check before sending” until Jo has seen a few.
Every name, address, job number, link and email below is invented. Figures follow the approved O18 quote example.

## Where is my job — Owner asking when their free Ready Check is

**Incoming email** (from Helen Sample <helen.sample@example.com>, subject “Re: Your spot is saved HV-3150”):

> Hi there,
> 
> Just wondering when is my free Ready Check? I haven't heard anything since I saved my spot.
> 
> Thanks,
> Helen

**Draft reply** (Outlook categories: Portal draft, Portal: Where is my job):

```text
Hi Helen,

Your free Ready Check is booked for Wednesday 28 October at 9am. The installer will measure your ceiling and confirm the price.

Jo, Home Insulation Victoria
```

Check before sending: no

## Price, rebate and eligibility — Owner says the price seems high and asks what the rebate covers

**Incoming email** (from Mark Sample <mark.sample@example.net>, subject “Re: Your quote is ready HV-3162”):

> Hi Jo,
> 
> The quote seems a lot higher than I expected. What does the rebate actually cover, and is there anything else I'd have to pay for?
> 
> Cheers,
> Mark

**Draft reply** (Outlook categories: Portal draft, Portal: Price, rebate and eligibility):

```text
Hi Mark,

Your quote's full price is $4,050 incl. GST, and the $1,850 VEU rebate comes straight off, so you pay $2,200 with nothing for you to claim. That includes the free Ready Check, the licensed electrician's safety check, premium R5.0 ceiling batts fitted by an EEC-certified installer, and all the rebate paperwork. Electrical fixes aren't included and are only needed if the safety check finds any; they're quoted separately and nothing is done without your OK. The rebate is for homes over 5 years old where any insulation already in the ceiling is below R2.0. You can see the full breakdown here: https://estimate.homeinsulationvictoria.com.au/estimate/SAMPLETOKEN

Jo, Home Insulation Victoria
```

Check before sending: no

## Price, rebate and eligibility — New sender asks about the rebate and price (no address in the email)

**Incoming email** (from SAM PERSON <sam.person@example.org>, subject “Insulation rebate”):

>

**Draft reply** (Outlook categories: Portal draft, Portal: Price, rebate and eligibility, Check before sending):

```text
Hi Sam,

Your price depends on the size of your ceiling, and the VEU rebate comes straight off it, with nothing for you to claim. That includes the free Ready Check, the licensed electrician's safety check, premium R5.0 ceiling batts fitted by an EEC-certified installer, and all the rebate paperwork. The rebate is for homes over 5 years old where any insulation already in the ceiling is below R2.0. Could you reply with your home's street address and suburb, so your enquiry is for the right home? Here's your own page: you can answer three quick questions and save your free spot: https://estimate.homeinsulationvictoria.com.au/estimate/SAMPLETOKEN3/campaign

Jo, Home Insulation Victoria
```

Check before sending: yes — New enquiry HV-3191 created from this email — check before sending (decision 255); No complete street address in the email — the enquiry has no address yet; this reply asks for it

## Installer / electrician — Installer asking where the Mitti form is and when they're paid

**Incoming email** (from Dan Sample <dan@sampleinsulation.example>, subject “Mitti form and pay”):

> Hi Jo,
> 
> Where do I find the Mitti form for the Ringwood job (HV-3171)? Also when am I getting paid for HV-3102?
> 
> Thanks
> Dan

**Draft reply** (Outlook categories: Portal draft, Portal: Installer / electrician):

```text
Hi Dan,

The job's Ready Check form appears in Mitti within about 15 minutes of the job being added, named with the customer's address and job number (for example HV-3171), under your inspections. Fill in as much as you can and press Complete only when it's finished, because that's what sends the owner their quote. Your next payment is due Friday 30 October for HV-3102. For your own customers you're paid when the owner pays the balance, and for our leads 7 days after we approve the job. Everything is in your portal: https://estimate.homeinsulationvictoria.com.au/field

Jo, Home Insulation Victoria
```

Check before sending: no
